review.evidence: At rise block 23375290, symbol/decimals and EIP-1967 implementation/admin were re-read. Local backing balance was 4,186,507.178834 M against 4,166,902.771484 USDR supply. M-extension wrapping and unwrapping conserve the deposited M claim. The current SwapFacility restricts direct M output to approved swappers; an unprivileged sample canSwapViaPath(child,wM) returned true while child-to-M returned false. This is technical conversion eligibility, not a sent transaction or a cash redemption right. Local role/proxy reach is authored separately from inherited M authority and the parent bridge layer. Calibration provenance (2026-10-03): original umbrella observations retained verbatim: ["Close current SwapFacility upgrade/role-control reach and all extension operational role holders.", "Safe owner/threshold and terminal module pagination are enumerated; executable fallback-handler noninterference, independent human signers and key custody are not publicly established."]. Human independence and key custody remain unverified and are priced by their dedicated control signals; financial/legal safeguards remain Backing-domain gaps. Calibration v2 (2026-10-03) reconsidered every prior removal and scoped move. Prior scoped observations retained verbatim: ["Close the current USDR local SwapFacility upgrade/role-control reach at rise:0xb6807116b3b1b321a390594e31ecd6e0076f6278; the local controller implementation and full permission/upgrade chain remain incompletely reviewed."]. Genuine unknown implementation, controller authorization and unreadable execution state are retained as umbrella questions; identified-signer custody/independence is recorded per control, not asserted to be independently scored or resolved. Field re-justification: reconciliation=continuous describes the cited local parent-token custody and wrap/custodian supply-accounting mechanism only. It does not certify the upstream fiat/Treasury book, independent assurance or holder insolvency priority; supervision=unknown supplies no prudential or attestation-based credit.
